$comment: Identity is frozen by artifacts/design/rule-catalog-v1.md. One rule in v1.0.0. The remaining Standard 21 requirements — bidirectional layout, locale-correct formatting, translated-length tolerance — are recorded there without mechanical support rather than given rules no evidence surface can establish.

rules.title: Displayed sentences are not assembled by concatenation
rules.description: User-facing sentences are single translatable units with parameters, not fragments joined at runtime.
rules.rationale: Concatenation encodes one language's grammar in the code. Word order, agreement, and pluralization differ per language, so the fragments cannot be reassembled correctly in any other one — and the defect is invisible to everyone who reads the original.
rules.remediation: Make the whole sentence one message with named placeholders, and handle plurals through the message rather than around it.
rules.$assuranceNote: Concatenation adjacent to a translation call is recognisable in source. Sentences assembled further from the call site are not, and this rule does not claim to find them.
